recommend.text: recommend. hm. you look like a pineapple bun person. or a congee person. ...you're not from here, are you.

looking.text: looking around. right. (wipes counter that doesn't need wiping.) this place has been here since before you were a thought. look all you want.

quiet.text: (sets down a cup of tea you didn't order. doesn't look at you.) ...it's on the house. don't get used to it.

newcomer.text: just arrived. (nods.) the city eats newcomers. but it also feeds them. ...you want the congee. trust me.

local_test.text: from here. (pauses. looks at you properly for the first time.) ...right. then you know the pineapple bun is the only correct answer.

come_back.text: come back. sure. (doesn't look up.) the door doesn't lock. never needed to.

thanks_resp.text: (grunts.) don't mention it. literally. ...you need anything else, i'm not the person to ask. but i'm the person who's here.

order_done.text: (calls to the kitchen without looking up.) one congee. ...it'll be five minutes. or ten. depends on whether the stove is in a good mood.
